input.summary: Ported matrix_rotate.cu to SYCL 2020 in port/matrix_rotate.cpp. No dpct headers, helpers, or DPCT macros remain; it compiles with icpx -fsycl (0 diagnostics, add_dpct_include=false). Kernel is a 1-D nd_range<1> (256-wide work-groups, global rounded up, guarded by layer < n/2) on an in-order queue with sycl::malloc_device/sycl::free. Output matches a serial C++ reference that applies the same rotation `repeat` times, byte-for-byte (cmp identical) for n=2048 rep=3, n=1000 rep=3, n=7 rep=1, n=1 rep=2, and n=2 rep=1. Caveat: the CUDA original was not built or run here, so the reference is a re-implementation of the same serial ring rotation, not the CUDA binary itself.
